title: Contract Management Specialist
summary: A contract management specialist runs the life of a company's contracts: preparing them from templates, redlining (marking changes on) the other side's drafts, getting approvals and tracking renewals and obligations. They usually sit in a legal operations or contracting team and work in a contract lifecycle management (CLM) tool.
dailyDuties: Prepare NDAs, MSAs and statements of work from approved templates
Redline counterparty contracts against the negotiation playbook
Route contracts for approval and signature in the CLM tool
Extract key terms and metadata into the contract repository
Track renewals, expiries and contract obligations
Escalate non-standard clauses to legal counsel
Report contract cycle times and pending requests to stakeholders

skills.expectation: Redline contracts against the negotiation playbook and escalate deviations
Prepare NDAs, MSAs, SOWs and amendments from approved templates and clause libraries
Run contract requests, approvals and the repository in a CLM tool such as Icertis, DocuSign CLM or SAP Ariba Contracts
Track obligations, renewal dates, notice periods and expiries
Extract key terms and metadata from signed contracts into the repository
Maintain contract trackers and cycle-time reports in Excel
Work with business, procurement, finance and legal teams on contract requests
Negotiate standard terms within the playbook
Understand basic contract law concepts behind common clauses
Look up clause standards and legal positions when asked by counsel
Write clear emails and escalation notes
